name: Pao'ka Swiftmountain
summary: Among Highperch's cliffs, Pao'ka Swiftmountain is trapped by the wyverns he came to study. He traveled south with Motega Firemane, but curiosity brought him too near their nesting grounds.

sections.title: A Naturalist in Trouble
sections.body:
Pao'ka came to Thousand Needles with Motega Firemane to study the canyon beasts. His father feared the journey was too perilous, and now Pao'ka's plight has proved him right.

The young scholar followed a mountain trail behind a solitary tauren totem, drawn by Highperch's wyverns. The territorial beasts drove him into the crags. Now he is trapped and terrified, with swooping wyverns barring his way back to Whitereach Post.

aliases: who is the tauren at highperch
faq.answer: Pao'ka is a young tauren scholar who came to Thousand Needles with Motega Firemane to study the region's wildlife. Territorial wyverns have trapped him on Highperch.

faq.q: Where can Pao'ka Swiftmountain be found?
faq.answer: Pao'ka is stranded atop Highperch in Thousand Needles. A narrow path climbs the mountainside behind a towering tauren totem near the cliffs and leads to the wyvern roosts.

faq.q: Why is he hiding in Highperch?
faq.answer: Pao'ka's fascination with wyverns brought him too close to one of their nests. The angry beasts drove him away and blocked his retreat, leaving him in hiding for several days.

faq.q: What happens after you help him escape?
faq.answer: After you lead Pao'ka safely out of the nesting grounds, he flees to Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post. He hopes his mentor will keep the blunder from his father.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help keep Pao'ka alive and preserve strong ties with the elders at Whitereach Post. He belongs to a new generation of tauren scholars exploring Kalimdor.
As a tauren, you know wyverns are deeply revered as allies and faithful mounts. Pao'ka's poorly planned intrusion is embarrassing and dangerous.
